name: xploresim
description: One Cloudflare Pages site for the XploreSim FRC match simulators: the 2026 REBUILT console at /rebuilt/, the 2025 REEFSCAPE console at /reefscape/ and the 2027 season console at /2027/, bound to xploresim.salmoncat0304.xyz

scripts.check:apps: npm --prefix rebuilt run check && npm --prefix reefscape run check && npm --prefix 2027 run check
scripts.test: npm --prefix rebuilt test && npm --prefix reefscape test && npm --prefix 2027 test
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run check:apps && npm test && npm run build
